A template will take the form <nowiki>{{X}}</nowiki>, where "X" is the word/abbreviation used to activate that template within the brackets.  A pipe ( | ) can be used after that to allow something else to be typed in its place, like this <nowiki>{{X|blah blah}}</nowiki>.  

To find the page for a specific template, type "Template:X" in the "Search" bar, where X = the word/abbreviation used.

For a comprehensive list of templates, see the [http://dwarffortresswiki.org/index.php?title=Special:AllPages&from=&namespace=10 list of all templates, by name].
